From 5576c4f24c56722a2d9fb9c447d896e5b312078b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>
Date: Sun, 16 Jan 2022 09:28:38 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ALSA: core: Fix SSID quirk lookup for subvendor=0

Some weird devices set the codec SSID vendor ID 0, and
snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id() loop aborts at the point although it should
still try matching with the SSID device ID.  This resulted in a
missing quirk for some old Macs.

Fix the loop termination condition to check both subvendor and
subdevice.

Fixes: 73355ddd8775 ("ALSA: hda: Code refactoring snd_hda_pick_fixup()")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
BugLink: https://bugzilla.kernel.org/show_bug.cgi?id=215495
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220116082838.19382-1-tiwai@suse.de
Signed-off-by: Takashi Iwai <tiwai@suse.de>

diff --git a/sound/core/misc.c b/sound/core/misc.c
index 3579dd7a161f..50e4aaa6270d 100644
--- a/sound/core/misc.c
+++ b/sound/core/misc.c
@@ -112,7 +112,7 @@ snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id(u16 vendor, u16 device,
 {
 	const struct snd_pci_quirk *q;
 
-	for (q = list; q->subvendor; q++) {
+	for (q = list; q->subvendor || q->subdevice; q++) {
 		if (q->subvendor != vendor)
 			continue;
 		if (!q->subdevice ||
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/core/misc.c`**
   - The loop termination condition in the function `snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id` was modified. 
   - The original condition checked only if `q->subvendor` was non-zero, which caused the loop to abort prematurely for certain devices with a subvendor ID of 0.
   - The new condition checks if either `q->subvendor` or `q->subdevice` is non-zero, allowing the loop to continue and check for matches with the SSID device ID even when the subvendor ID is 0.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a bug where certain devices (specifically some old Macs) were not being matched correctly due to the loop terminating early when encountering a subvendor ID of 0. 
- By changing the loop condition, the patch ensures that the function can still find the appropriate quirks for devices that have a subvendor ID of 0, thus improving the robustness of the quirk lookup process in the ALSA core. 
- This change is linked to a previous commit that refactored the `snd_hda_pick_fixup()` function, indicating that the issue arose from changes made in that refactoring. The patch also references a bug report that highlights the problem being fixed.

missing quirk for some old Macs.

Fix the loop termination condition to check both subvendor and

Fixes: 73355ddd8775 ("ALSA: hda: Code refactoring snd_hda_pick_fixup()")

The bug was caused by the loop in the `snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id` function terminating prematurely when it encountered a codec SSID vendor ID of 0. The original loop condition only checked for a non-zero subvendor, which prevented the function from continuing to check for matches with the SSID device ID, leading to missing quirks for certain devices, particularly some old Macs.

  */
 const struct snd_pci_quirk *
 snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id(u16 vendor, u16 device,
 			const struct snd_pci_quirk *list)
 {
 	const struct snd_pci_quirk *q;
 
-	for (q = list; q->subvendor; q++) {
+	for (q = list; q->subvendor || q->subdevice; q++) {
 		if (q->subvendor != vendor)
 			continue;
 		if (!q->subdevice ||
 		    (device & q->subdevice_mask) == q->subdevice)
 			return q;
 	}
 	return NULL;
 }
 EXPORT_SYMBOL(snd_pci_quirk_lookup_id);
